admission.justification: The retention test retries a reclaimed identity and counts runner calls; retaining this rule prevents duplicate model sessions after old attempt records are removed.

applicability: Explicit presenter starts retried with a request ID whose attempt record was reclaimed.
conditions: The bounded request ledger still retains that request-to-attempt mapping.
exclusions: Request IDs no longer retained by the bounded ledger.
An explicit replacement with a new request identity.
statement: When the presenter request ledger still names a reclaimed attempt, retrying that request must refuse with attempt-record-reclaimed and must not start another session.
